summary: Use runtime semantics for general instanceof because Symbol.hasInstance and constructor prototypes are dynamically observable.

target.notes: Must implement InstanceofOperator/GetMethod(Symbol.hasInstance) and OrdinaryHasInstance behavior, including callable checks, bound functions, prototype-chain traversal, and TypeErrors.

caveats: C# 'is' checks CLR type identity/inheritance and is not equivalent to JavaScript instanceof.
Mutating ctor.prototype can change future instanceof results.

tests.name: normal constructor instance
tests.input: class A{}; const a=new A(); console.log(a instanceof A);

tests.name: edge custom Symbol.hasInstance
tests.input: const C={ [Symbol.hasInstance](x){ return x===42; } }; console.log(42 instanceof C);
